value.lineage: CLIPS (1985, NASA JSC, Gary Riley): forward-chaining production-rule system with a Rete pattern matcher, later with COOL objects; the public-domain expert-system shell

HUMAN_PROBLEM.value: encoding and executing expert knowledge as production rules

value.built_to: let domain experts encode knowledge as if-then rules over facts and have the machine chain them forward to conclusions, without writing procedural code
value.pressure: NASA needed portable, embeddable, verifiable expert systems in the mid-1980s when Lisp machines were expensive; Rete makes rule matching incremental
value.success_means: the right rules fire on the right facts, in a defensible order (salience, conflict resolution), fast enough for real-time use

cut.note: a Rete engine: facts enter a join network from the right, are matched against the left memory of each join by hash then by test expression, and successful partial matches drive down to the next join; a complete match becomes an activation placed on an agenda ordered by salience group and a strategy; Run pops and fires; the three are separable and are the three files read

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.mechanism: a new partial match entering a join from the right (a new fact) is compared against the join's left beta memory, fetched by hash value so only bucket-mates are scanned; matching hash and no blocking marker lead to the join's compiled test expression (variable bindings across patterns); success drives the combined partial match to the child joins (PPDrive); negated and exists patterns instead add blocked links and retract dependents; the first join of a rule short-circuits (EmptyDrive); incremental reset can skip joins not being rebuilt
organs.input: a partial match from the alpha side; the join's left memory
organs.output: new partial matches downstream, or blocked links
organs.state: beta memories (per join, hashed), markers, blocked links
assumptions: most joins fail early, so hashing the beta memory on the join's equality tests pays; state (partial matches) is retained between cycles so matching is incremental (the Rete premise: many rules, slowly changing facts)
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: matching cost per fact change is proportional to the change, not to the rule base
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: beta memories can grow combinatorially on cross-product joins (the classic Rete failure); the DEVELOPER counters in the source measure exactly that
organs.human_prior: Forgy 1982 Rete; the hashed beta memories are CLIPS 6.30's addition

organs.human_name: AddActivation / PlaceActivation / salienceGroup / GetNextActivation (agenda.c); Strategy (depth, breadth, LEX, MEA, complexity, simplicity, random)
organs.mechanism: a complete match becomes an activation carrying the rule, the matched facts, a time tag and a salience (evaluated when defined, at activation, or every cycle per a setting); activations live in per-module agendas partitioned into salience groups (a linked list ordered by salience, reused per value); within a group a strategy orders them (default DEPTH: newest first; also breadth, LEX and MEA on fact recency, complexity/simplicity on rule size, random); Run takes the first
assumptions: the programmer's salience says what matters; the strategy breaks ties; nothing about the facts' content beyond recency is used
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the only place 'which rule when' is decided; every expert-system control idiom is a salience/strategy pattern
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: salience is a global scalar, so control logic leaks into rule priorities (the well-known expert-system maintenance problem)
organs.human_prior: OPS5's conflict-resolution strategies (Forgy) with CLIPS's salience groups as an efficiency structure

organs.mechanism: while activations remain and the run limit is not reached: take the first activation, mark the rule firing, evaluate its right-hand side (which asserts/retracts facts, re-entering the join network immediately), count the firing, handle garbage collection of transient values and the debugging watches; a re-entrant call is refused (AlreadyRunning)
assumptions: a rule's actions change the world and the match is incremental, so the cycle is match-select-act with match amortised
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the production-system loop; everything else exists to make its match step cheap

pressures.condition: R rules with multi-pattern conditions over F facts; each cycle changes a few facts; the organism must find every newly satisfied rule instance and choose one to fire
pressures.resource_or_constraint: memory for retained partial matches; time per fact change
pressures.failure_condition: re-matching every rule against every fact per cycle (cost R x F^k), or memory blow-up on cross-product joins
pressures.world_rewards: retained, hashed partial matches shared across rules
pressures.observable_consequence: time per cycle vs R and F with the beta memories enabled vs disabled; memory vs join selectivity
pressures.vacuity_condition: one rule or one fact change per run
pressures.trivial_shortcuts: a world where facts never change
pressures.cheat_control: an organism told which rules changed status must fire the same sequence at zero match cost; naive re-matching must show the R x F^k scaling: the world must show both
